judgment.rationale: The report has enough reproduction detail and configuration to move to maintainer testing, not another generic log request. Alternating hide/restore is a supported candidate mechanism; profiling is needed to distinguish cursor reload cost, queued work and other software. If unfixed, simultaneous typing/movement can make input visibly stutter.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce with typing-only versus idle-only settings and trace transitions before deciding whether coalescing or a different visibility strategy is necessary.
evidence: The reporter describes stuttering while holding a keyboard key and moving the pointer, and supplies a diagnostic archive.
Archive settings enable hide_on_typing and hide_on_idle with a5000ms idle delay.
Current-main AutoHideCursorState hides after nonmodifier keyboard input and shows after intentional mouse movement; repeated alternating input can therefore request repeated transitions.

Worker queues cursor actions outside hook callbacks; SystemCursorHider changes system cursors and restores them using SPI_SETCURSORS/refresh. This does not establish measured hook latency or prove a synchronous hook implementation.

title: CursorHide make mouse lag when holding keyboard button.

prerequisites: Windows desktop with CursorHide available; record current cursor scheme.
Maintainer tracing of transition counts/durations and input latency.
steps: Enable typing hiding only, hold a nonmodifier key and continuously move the mouse; compare single key presses.
Repeat with idle hiding only and then both options with5000ms idle delay.
Trace actual Hide/Show queue and operation durations; repeat without other pointer utilities if the first run reproduces.
reproduce.expected: Pointer movement remains responsive and restores a visible cursor; cursor operations do not accumulate obsolete work.

fix_assessment.rationale: The transition path supplies a focused investigation, but latency and the safe corrective policy are not proven.

proposed_fixes.title: Bound cursor-hide work during simultaneous keyboard and mouse input
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Key repeat and intentional movement can alternate Hide/Show requests. Repeated system-cursor replacement/restoration may cause the observed lag; no timing proof exists yet.
verification: Exercise held-key movement, isolated typing, clicks, wheel, modifier-only input, idle expiry and module shutdown.
Compare transition counts and pointer latency before/after on the same machine; confirm all user cursors restore after disable, crash recovery and failed cursor operations.

confidence.rationale: The configured input sequence matches a real state transition path, but no profiler measurement or reproduced latency establishes the expensive operation.

plan: Reproduce typing-only, idle-only and combined configurations with single key presses versus held-key repeat while continuously moving.
Measure queued action count, Hide/Show duration and pointer latency; distinguish transition churn from injected-input or third-party interference.
If churn is confirmed, coalesce obsolete pending visibility work or reduce repeated system-cursor mutation while preserving immediate pointer restoration, idle behavior and original cursor schemes.
